journey.title: Ticking a checkbox inside the preferences dialog keeps it open
journey.goal: Space ticks the checkbox and the dialog stays open

functionalJourney.title: Open and close preferences with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: The dialog opens and the close button dismisses it

guards.title: Done closes the preferences dialog from the keyboard
guards.goal: Activating Done dismisses the dialog and focus returns to the trigger

plan.root_cause: The Space keypress on the checkbox unexpectedly closes the preferences modal, likely due to an intervening listener that treats Space as a close action.
plan.repair_strategy: Add an early return for Space (keyCode 32) in the Modal's onKeydown handler to prevent the key from propagating to any close logic while preserving existing ESC and Tab handling.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Pressing Space on the weekly digest checkbox will toggle its state without closing the dialog, keeping the modal open and accessible.
functional_risks: If any other component relied on Space to close the modal via this listener, that behavior will be lost.
verification_requirements: Verify that Space on #weekly toggles the checkbox and leaves #prefs-modal with aria-hidden='false'.
Confirm that ESC still closes the modal and restores focus to the trigger.
Confirm that Tab still traps focus within the modal.

plan.root_cause: The modal overlay element has the close trigger attribute (data-micromodal-close) and is an ancestor of the checkbox. When the checkbox receives a Space keypress, the browser synthesizes a click event that bubbles up to the overlay, causing the modal to close.
plan.repair_strategy: Restructure the modal HTML so the overlay is a sibling of the container rather than its parent, and adjust CSS to keep the overlay as a full-screen backdrop and the container centered. This prevents clicks inside the container from bubbling to the overlay.

<style>
body{font:18px system-ui,sans-serif;margin:0;padding:32px;color:#111;background:#fff}
button,input{font:inherit}
button{padding:10px 16px}
:focus{outline:3px solid #0050c8;outline-offset:2px}
.modal{display:none}
.modal.is-open{display:block}
.modal__overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);}
.modal__container{position:fixed;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);background:#fff;padding:24px;max-width:420px;width:90%;border-radius:6px;}
fieldset{border:1px solid #555;margin:0 0 16px}
</style>
